## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Docs updated (README, docs or CONTRIBUTING) if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] `npm run licence:check` run, and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` committed, if a dependency changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, keys or personal data (names, e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IP addresses, domains) in the diff, screenshots or logs
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording attached for any change you can see in the UI
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...)
